about BBY
BBY (Beauty By You) is building the operating system for independent service professionals who run their own business. Our mobile app manages everything from bookings to payments to client relationships, and gives every user a custom booking website + portfolio. On top of that, AI agents handle the busywork so they can focus on what they do best.

we're growing fast and looking for our first full-time Founding Engineer to join us and help shape the future of the company.

what you'll do

work directly with the founders to design and build core product features across mobile, web, and backend

own major parts of the product from 0 to 1 and beyond

make key architectural decisions as we scale our platform

collaborate on everything from UX to database design to infrastructure

jump in on feature bugs and improvements

our stack

frontend: React Native (Expo), Next.js

backend: Node.js, Python

infra: Supabase, Vercel, Google Cloud, Expo, Firebase, Github, Stripe

what we’re looking for

1+ years experience as a full-stack or mobile app engineer

experience shipping real products (startups, side projects, freelance, etc)

passion for startups and building things from the ground up

willing to work IN-PERSON full-time in Utah County

why join now?

be the first engineering hire and shape the product, tech, and culture from day one

work on a product that’s actually helping small business owners thrive

competitive early-stage salary with meaningful equity

fast-paced environment with lots of room to grow

currently unable to sponsor employment visas.
